post.summary: Registers a new account with the Participant or Organiser role.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: The new user's name, email, password, optional phone number, and role.

409.description: An account with this email already exists.

500.description: The requested role is not configured.

post.summary: Authenticates a user and creates a session.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: The user's registered email and password.

200.description: Login succeeded and a session was created.

401.description: The credentials are invalid or the account role is unavailable.

post.summary: Ends the current session by clearing its session data.
